description: This source file contains the implementation of the StreamingImmutabilityTestGrain class, which is a grain component in an Orleans distributed application framework. It manages subscription to a stream of StreamImmutabilityTestObject objects, sending objects to the stream, and maintains an internal state object. Additionally, it defines the StreamImmutabilityTestObject class with a serializable string property.

classes.name: StreamingImmutabilityTestGrain
classes.description: A grain implementation that manages stream subscription and message handling for StreamImmutabilityTestObject objects, enabling testing of immutability and streaming features in Orleans.

classes.name: StreamImmutabilityTestObject
classes.description: A serializable data class representing objects sent over the stream, with a single string property MyString.

methods.name: SubscribeToStream
methods.description: Subscribes to a specified stream identified by GUID and provider name, setting up OnNextAsync as the callback for incoming messages.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromStream
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the current stream subscription if it exists.

methods.name: SendTestObject
methods.description: Sends the internal _myObject to the specified stream identified by provider name and the grain's primary key.

methods.name: SetTestObjectStringProperty
methods.description: Sets the MyString property of the internal _myObject, initializing it if null.

methods.name: GetTestObjectStringProperty
methods.description: Returns the MyString property of the internal _myObject.

methods.name: GetSiloIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the silo hosting this grain.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new object arrives from the stream; updates _myObject accordingly.
